summary.text: Kristin Kassner is a Democratic state representative from the 2nd Essex District who took office in February 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works as a policy director and certified planning professional.

paragraphs.text: Kristin Kassner was born in Boston, Massachusetts, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Miami University in 2001 and a graduate degree from Tufts University in 2008.
Her career experience includes working as a policy director and certified planning professional.
Kassner assumed office on February 3, 2023, succeeding Republican Leonard Mirra.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and to the Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture; Municipalities and Regional Government; Revenue; and Ways and Means joint committees.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
